thread:
maya: quick async check-in: pushed a small fix to the Node SDK quickstart sample (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/512). Problem was the install script using `npm run build` before `npm ci` — noisy on CI mac runners.

samir: nice, thanks. can you drop the short snippet of the failing log? want to see if it's the environment or a script ordering issue.

maya: pasted the log below — build step errored with missing node_modules.
```
Error: Cannot find module 'some-dep'
 at Function.Module._resolveFilename (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
```

ben: dev note: I hit a different flake on linux container where the sample's e2e timed out (selenium stub). pulling that into a separate issue: #513 so we don't block the doc fix.

olivia: re: docs — i updated the quickstart README to clarify `node >= 18` and added the `npm ci` ordering tip. left a small wording nit for you @maya on the PR.

maya: thanks @olivia, I'll address the wording. tagging @samir for a quick review on the script change.

samir: taking a look now. minor suggestion: switch to a combined command in package.json "prepare:ci": "npm ci && npm run build" instead of relying on CI job ordering. keeps local repro simpler.

maya: good call. I'll update the package.json.

ci-bot: CI run started for PR #512 — node-18-mac matrix.

ben: FYI, I added a tiny Cypress smoke test in the samples repo that just loads the homepage — should catch the e2e timeouts earlier. it's in branch `samples/cypress-smoke`. will open PR after #513 is triaged.

maya: blockers: none after the change, just need a +1 from @samir and one from docs to merge. planned today: update package.json, push fix, and squash commits.

olivia: scheduled to review after lunch. will also check for a couple of broken cross-links in the quickstart nav while i'm at it.

samir: gave +1 on the script approach, added a short comment inline.

maya: pushed update, CI re-run — ping when you see green.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #512 (all matrices green). :tada:

olivia: merging now and will backfill the cross-link fixes in a follow-up PR.

maya: merged — thanks team! small retrospective: add a checklist item to quickstart authoring guide: "run full CI matrix locally with `./scripts/local-ci`" (file: docs/devex/quickstart-authoring.md). i'll open a PR to add the checklist.

docs-bot: created issue #514: "Quickstart authoring checklist — run CI matrix locally" (assignee: maya).

ben: awesome, that should reduce churn. i'll queue up the cypress PR after #513 is resolved.

maya: last note — if anyone sees flaky mac runners in the next 24h, please drop a short message here so we can batch those into a single infra bug.

samir: will do. cheers.
